compared_against_content_true.why_it_matters: If this is true, GreenhouseAdapter.normalize can be reused for phase-2 payloads rather than duplicated, and there is no second normalization path for the location parser to drift in. The committed test asserts it, so a future divergence fails loudly instead of producing two different canonical jobs for one posting.
